component.name: Advanced IP Analyser
component.summary: Discover, inventory, and access authorized network devices

description.p: Advanced IP Analyser is a Debian network scanner and device inventory application. It discovers reachable hosts, TCP services, names, MAC addresses, manufacturers, and bounded service metadata.

Saved devices, safe inventory exchange, Wake-on-LAN, remote service launchers, long-running Network Watch analysis, passive Wi-Fi observation, built-in packet display filters, confirmed SSH power actions, and verified in-application updates support routine network administration.
